title: Aa Jao Maa Zahra (s.a)
body:
Bahot Hi Sakht Manzil Bachpane Mein Maa Ki Furqat
Bina Madar Ke Pahli Raat Bachhon Par Qayamat Hai
Bahot Ghabra Rahi Hai Fatima Ki Ladli Zainab
Labon Par Bain Hai, Amma Akeli Ho Gayi Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghar Tum Bin Soona Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
Dil Mera Phat Ta Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
1.
Bohot Uljhan Hai Is Dil Mein,
Chali Aao Kahan Ho Tum
Tumhe To Ye Pata Hai Na,
Mera Saara Jahan Ho Tum
Ye Beti Tanha Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
2.
Lahad Mein Tum Akeli Ho, Mujhe Kaise Qaraar Aaye
Kahin Phir Se Koi Zaalim Tumhe Iza Na Pahunchaye
Dar Mujhko Lagta Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
3.
Bichhadne Ka Ye Gham Amma, Nahi Mujhse Saha Jaata
Chali Aao, Bina Maa Ke Mujhe Jeena Nahi Aata
Sin Mera Chhota Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
4.
Hussain Ab Tak Nahi Soya, Ise Lori Suna Do Tum
Liye Paani Main Baithi Hoon, Zara Aakhri Pila Do Tum
Shahzada Pyaasa Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
5.
Mere Aage Hasan Roye, Ye Gham Kaise Sahe Zainab
Tamaachon Ki Sada Dil Se Juda Kaise Kare Zainab
Uljhan Mein Bhaiya Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
6.
Bharosa Tha Mujhe Har Dam, Museebat Mein Sambhalogi
Kabhi Bhi Jab Main Roungi, Gale Se Tum Laga Logi
Dil Mera Toota Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
7.
Sahi Jaati Nahi Mujhse Mere Baba Ki Mayoosi
Kahe Kisse Wo Gham Apna, Mite Kaise Ghutan Dil Ki
Mushkil Mein Baba Hai, Aajaao Maa Zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
8.
Nadeem Haal-E-Dil-E-Zainab Bayan Kaise Kare Koi
Pata Hai Ab Kabhi Amma Palat Ke Ghar Na Aayegi
Dil Phir Bhi Kehta Hai, Aa Jaao Maa Zahra
author: Nadeem Sultanpuri
